title: Chest pain with ST elevation, 58-year-old man (saved regression case 1)
provenance: Vignette written 2026-09-30 for the evaluation harness; expected answers extracted from the cited documents.

intake.complaint: Central crushing chest pain radiating to the left arm for 1 hour, with sweating.

triage.note: Adjudicated (C): MTS cells give Level 2; the ACS CPG 2026 p85 places STEMI in 'RED or MTS Level 1 or 2', so Level 1 is accepted as well. Both extractors: level 2. A: Level 2 cells that apply (by x-position): ECG row p7 'ST elevations or depressions' (x~131 = Level 2); Chest Pain complaint p8 'New Onset < 6 H', 'On-going chest pain', 'Profuse sweating', 'STEMI / NSTEMI / UA (referral)' (all x~131 = Level 2); primary triage Critical First Look p4 'Severe Chest Pain' (x~246 = Level 2). No Level 1 cell applies (not arrested, no shock, SpO2 96%). The ACS CPG 2026 places STEMI in a critical zone 'RED or MTS Level 1 or 2', so Level 1 is also defensible. B: ECG 'ST elevations or depressions' is a Level 2 cell (adult vital signs p7, ECG row, x~131). Chest pain complaint Level 2 cells (p8, x~131): 'New Onset < 6 H', 'On-going chest pain', 'Profuse sweating', 'STEMI / NSTEMI / UA (referral)'. Primary triage 'Severe Chest Pain' is Level 2 (p4, x~246). RR 20 and pain 7 are only Level 3 (p7, x~244); HR 96, BP 150/90 and SpO2 96 are not abnormal. No Level 1 criterion (cardiac arrest, severe respiratory distress, shock) is present. The ACS CPG groups MTS Levels 1 and 2 together as the critical (red) zone.

adjudication.method: two independent extraction passes (A, B); agreed items scored
notes: C widened triage acceptable to [1,2] on ACS CPG 2026 p85 (extractor A's evidence).

A: The corpus holds both the ACS CPG 2026 and the older NSTE-ACS CPG 2021; only the 2026 ACS CPG was used. Should older STEMI/NSTEMI guidance be treated as superseded?
Level 1 versus Level 2: the MTS cells for STEMI are all Level 2, but the ACS CPG allows 'MTS Level 1 or 2' for STEMI. Recorded as level 2 with 1 acceptable.
Nitrates are contraindicated with PDE5-inhibitor use, SBP < 90 or RV infarction. None of these is recorded in the intake, so nitrates are not listed as forbidden.
B: The triage level from the MTS cells is 2. The ACS CPG's red zone covers MTS Levels 1 and 2 together; the adjudicator may choose to accept 1.
